finding.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval', so the policy does not stop an injected script from executing.
finding.title: Content-Security-Policy permits inline script

regeneration.note: The response header is the whole finding, so the CSP is sanitized token by token: directives and keywords stay, allowlisted origins do not.
